release_notes.en-US: Tab Snooze System: inactive tabs auto-unload from memory. UI polish, Firebase security hardening, CI/CD pipeline.

summary.en-US: Collapse all open tabs into a searchable dashboard. Reduce memory usage by up to 95% and reclaim your focus.

description.en-US: Lorapok TabMan is a next-generation Firefox tab manager. One click collapses all open tabs into a structured, searchable dashboard. Features include cloud sync via Firebase, hierarchical tagging, bulk operations, Tab Snooze (auto-unload inactive tabs), analytics, and keyboard shortcuts.
